source: Local runtime checkpoint snapshots, read-only; no source edits or matches launched
uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals over mean of the two seat-swapped games per seed; latest confirmation30pairs uses t29=2.045. Descriptive unadjusted intervals, no multiplicity correction; incomplete seed pairs excluded from intervals but included in raw summaries. Higher-df t critical approximated by expansion.

audit: SHA256 of original checkpoint bytes and each retained per-game JSON byte stream. Per-game manifest hash is SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON manifest. Counts are game records, not independent trials; repeated seeds and seat pairs are correlated. Extra retained per-game records are separate and deduplicated by run+taskid.
